ATSB sonar coverage envelope (GA, all sensors)
properties.pod_basis: ATSB 2017 (Operational Search, pp.95-96, Fig.73): combined 97.4% high-confidence coverage (>95% detection), 2.1% lower-POD (50-90%, nominal 70%), 0.5% gaps (0%). Mid = 0.974*0.975+0.021*0.7 = 0.96. Low additionally x0.9 for imagery-review / classification misses and holidays not captured by the 100 m metric; high = HC 100%, LC 90%. Applied only where no Fig.73 area polygon applies.

properties.name: GO Phoenix terrain gap near HPSA (CAPTION KMZ)
properties.pod_basis: CAPTION KMZ: gap in GO Phoenix SAS coverage near the HPSA (55 km2). ATSB d=0 (high bound 0.5: deep-tow / AUV may have covered parts). OI 2018 coverage there is applied from the OI 2018 polygons where they overlap.

properties.name: High Priority Search Area (never scanned per Iannello 2023)
properties.pod_basis: Iannello (radiantphysics, 11 Feb 2023): ~30.5 km2 around 34.53S 93.84E 'never scanned' (steep slope missed by GO Phoenix, half-scanned by OI 2018). ATSB d=0.
properties.source: V. Iannello 11 Feb 2023 'A High Priority Area to Search for MH370' (Priority-Area-Zoom.png)

properties.name: Bluefin-21 AUV search area Apr-May 2014 (GA)
properties.pod_basis: Bluefin-21 AUV side-scan, Apr-May 2014, ~860 km2 around the Ocean Shield acoustic detections (GA feature service polygon). ATSB: no aircraft debris found. Lies ~5 km from the sea-level 7th arc at 21.1S, so it is arc coverage.

properties.name: OI 2018 inter-site junction gaps (<3 km, closed)
properties.pod_basis: Gaps < ~3 km between adjacent digitised OI 2018 sites (e.g. Site 1/2 at 32.4S). The official maps show the sites abutting, so best/high treat them as covered with the site POD; the low bound treats them as real gaps.
properties.source: morphological closing (1.5 km) of the digitised OI 2018 union

properties.name: ATSB / OI 2018 junction slivers (<3 km, uncertain)
properties.pod_basis: Slivers < ~3 km wide between the ATSB coverage edge (0.5 km accurate) and the digitised OI 2018 site edges (+/-1-2 km), mostly along the Site-1 legs at 34.7-36S. Could be digitising error (then covered, 0.92) or real unsearched slivers (0): best = 0.5 x 0.92.
properties.source: closing (1.5 km) of ATSB u OI 2018 minus both, within 3 km of each

properties.name: OI 2018 northern sweep 30 May-7 Jun (INFERRED)
properties.pod_basis: 30 May-7 Jun 2018 sweep to ~25S, no official map; 'gaps between AUV tracks opened out again' (R. Cole, AirlineRatings 31 May 2018); AUVs recovered early, one AUV swath 5.2 km vs 7.4 km (Godfrey). Geometry inferred from AIS; the CAPTION community outline independently reaches 24.73S.
properties.source: Inferred: no official map. Evidence: Seabed Constructor AIS track (community KMZ, LabratSR Dropbox, data/derived/oi2018_search/seabed_constructor_track_2018.csv) reaching 25.80S (31 May), 25.10S (4 Jun), 24.76S (6 Jun); V. Iannello 8 Jun 2018 "searched as far north as 25S and at a width of at least +/-22 NM"; R. Godfrey daily comments on radiantphysics.com (31 May - 7 Jun 2018); AirlineRatings 31 May 2018 (OI spokesman: vessel to remain a few days to sweep the area of the 2014 Chinese ping near 25S 101E).

properties.name: OI 2018 Site 4 planned box (completion inferred)
properties.pod_basis: Planned Site-4 box NE of the 27 May coverage; completion ~27-30 May inferred from the AIS track, not from an official map.
properties.source: Government of Malaysia, "MH370 Operational Search Update" #18 (2018-05-29), page 3 Diagram 3, Site 4 survey box outline (P04S04_v7); archived PDF via web.archive.org of http://mh370.gov.my/en/mh370-underwater-search-2018?download=... (file weekly_updates/OSU18_2018-05-29.pdf, figure figures_extracted/OSU18_p3_x40_499x521.png)

properties.name: OI 2018 Site1
properties.pod_basis: OI 2018 Hugin AUVs (side-scan + MBES), 'high quality data in which we have full confidence' (OI 30 Apr 2018); OI reportedly estimated ~99% coverage (Godfrey, 28 May 2018, unofficial); a second-hand 3.1% data-holiday figure exists. No official POD was published; Broken Ridge terrain is difficult. Best 0.92, low 0.80, high 0.98.
